blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Rub a small amount into the palms of your hands until warmed and gently massage onto desired areas as needed to moisturize.

This product is naturally solid and the color and texture will vary depending on the ambient temperature. Fluctuations in the temperature may produce fat crystals that affect the color and texture of the product, making it appear grainy or clumpy. This is natural and may affect the appearance, but will not harm the quality of the product. If solid, shea butter can be softened by placing the container in hot water or by microwaving until soft.
